title: Learning Graph Schema
description: Schema for learning graph JSON files that define concept nodes, dependencies, and taxonomies for educational content

title.description: The title of the course or subject

description.description: A brief description of the course content

creator.description: The name of the person or organization who created this learning graph

date.description: The creation or last modification date (YYYY-MM-DD)

version.description: Version number of the learning graph

format.description: The format specification of this learning graph

schema.description: URL to the JSON schema for this learning graph

license.description: The license under which this learning graph is distributed

classifierName.description: Human-readable name for this taxonomy category

color.description: Color value (hex code like #ff0000 or CSS color name like DarkRed)

font.description: Font styling for text in nodes

nodes.description: Array of concept nodes in the learning graph

group.description: The taxonomy group this concept belongs to (must match a key in groups)

shape.description: Optional vis.js shape for the node (e.g., 'box', 'circle', 'ellipse')

title.description: Optional tooltip text shown when hovering over the node

level.description: Optional hierarchical level for layout purposes

cis.description: Concept Impact Score: a PageRank-style recursive importance measure over the dependency graph, computed as 1 plus the sum of the CIS of every concept that directly depends on this one (transitively capturing how much of the book's total understanding ultimately rests on this concept). Minimum value is 1 (a terminal concept with no dependents). Computed automatically by csv-to-json.py during learning-graph.json generation -- see the 'Predicting Concept Content Size' paper (Definition 3, Proposition 1) for the full derivation.

edges.description: Array of directed edges representing dependencies between concepts

from.description: Source node ID (dependent concept -- the concept that requires 'to' as a prerequisite). CORRECTED 2026-08-24: earlier versions of this schema had 'from'/'to' reversed relative to how every skill in this project (book-chapter-generator, chapter-content-generator) and every generated learning-graph.json actually uses these fields. The edge direction is DEPENDENCY, not enablement: edge {from: 5, to: 1} means concept 5 depends on concept 1, i.e. concept 1 must be learned first. See the 'CRITICAL: Edge Direction' warnings in book-chapter-generator/SKILL.md and chapter-content-generator/SKILL.md.

to.description: Target node ID (prerequisite concept -- the concept 'from' depends on). See the note on 'from' above.
